in_arabic.name: مُعَلَّم
in_arabic.long_meaning: المُعَلَّمُ: المُدرّس، المُربّي، المُصوّب، المُشير إلى الشخص الذي يُربي الآخرين، ويُعلمهم، ويَدربهم على الطريق السوي، ومعناهُ أيضاً العليم، الذي يَقضي حياتَهُ في تعليم الآخرين، وَهو من أسماءِ الله التي ذكرت في القرآن الكريم، وقد صارت هذه الصفة إحدى أسماءِ النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، لأنه كان من أوعبيط الناس في الدعوة إلى الله، وقد استعملت هذه الصفة في العديد من الأسماء في الإسلام، مثل: محمد المُتَمَلّك، وعلي المُتَمَلّك، وَغيرها، وَهي من أهم الأسماء في الإسلام التي تعبر عن الحكمة، والعلم، والمعرفة

in_urdu.name: معلم
in_urdu.meaning: معلم: وہ شخص جسے دوسروں کو تعلیم دینی ہوتی ہے،
in_urdu.long_meaning: معلم: وہ شخص جسے دوسروں کو تعلیم دینی ہوتی ہے، جس کے ذریعے لوگ علم اور حکمت حاصل کرتے ہیں، اور وہ ان کی رشد و هدیٰ میں مدد کرتا ہے، اور انہیں صحیح راستہ پر لاتا ہے، اور یہ نام ایک اہم نام ہے جو اسلام میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور یہ نام نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے لئے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، کیونکہ انہوں نے اسلام کی تعلیم کو پھیلایا، اور لوگوں کو صحیح راستہ پر لایا، اور یہ نام ان تمام لوگوں کے لئے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے جو دوسروں کو تعلیم دیتے ہیں، یا انہیں صحیح راستہ پر لاتے ہیں، جیسے کہ اساتذہ، یا مایں باپ، یا وہ شخص جسے لوگ اپنے مسائل کے حل کے لئے پوچھتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: मुअल्लम
in_hindi.meaning: मुअल्लम: जो व्यक्ति दूसरों को शिक्षा देता है,
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुअल्लम: जो व्यक्ति दूसरों को शिक्षा देता है, जो उनकी राह दिखाता है, जो उन्हें सही रास्ते पर ले जाता है, और जो उनकी رشد और हिदायत में मदद करता है, यह नाम एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो इस्लाम में प्रयोग किया जाता है, और यह नाम नबी मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि व सल्लम के लिए भी प्रयोग किया जाता है, क्योंकि उन्होंने इस्लाम की शिक्षा को फैलाया, और लोगों को सही रास्ते पर ले गए, और यह नाम उन सभी लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो दूसरों को शिक्षा देते हैं, या उन्हें सही रास्ते पर लाते हैं, जैसे कि शिक्षक, या माँ-बाप, या वह व्यक्ति जिसे लोग अपने समस्याओं के समाधान के लिए पूछते हैं

in_english.name: Muallam
in_english.meaning: Muallam: a teacher, educator, guide, instructor, or one who imparts knowledge
in_english.long_meaning: Muallam: a teacher, educator, guide, instructor, or one who imparts knowledge, a person who conveys wisdom, science, and knowledge to others, a guide who directs people on the right path, a mentor who trains and educates, a person who imparts knowledge and wisdom to others, in the Islamic tradition, the name Muallam is associated with the Prophet Muhammad, who was a teacher, educator, and guide, and who imparted knowledge and wisdom to his followers, the name Muallam is also used to describe a person who is knowledgeable, wise, and skilled in imparting knowledge to others, and who is a source of guidance and wisdom for others

data.cultural_impact: The title of Muallam held significant social and cultural status, indicative of an accomplished scholar and teacher in the Islamic world. The transmission of knowledge and wisdom was considered a core element of society, which enabled continuous learning and growth. Within their communities, Muallams were revered for their expertise and were often consulted for guidance on matters related to Islamic law, practice and theology.
data.spiritual_significance: For Muslims, the title Muallam carried strong spiritual connotations. It represented the perpetuation of the Prophet Muhammad's mission to transmit knowledge and wisdom to future generations. The pursuit of knowledge and understanding in Islamic teachings was viewed as an essential means to seek nearness to God and to strengthen one's faith. Through their role as teachers and mentors, Muallams were instrumental in guiding individuals on their spiritual journey, fostering a deeper connection to their religious practices and instilling piety within their students.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta, a renowned traveler from Morocco, mentions a man named Muallim Abdul Wahid, who was a Sufi scholar and teacher in Bukhara during the 14th century. Muallim Abdul Wahid is known for establishing a Sufi lodge and attracting numerous followers due to his deep knowledge and piety.

Al-Muqaddasi, a geographer from Baghdad, describes Muallim Ahmad ibn Ubayd al-Ansari, a famous scholar and transmitter of hadith during the early Islamic period (9th-10th centuries). He was named Muallim due to his extensive knowledge and ability to teach various Islamic sciences to students. The name Muallim means 'teacher' in Arabic.

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Muallam', which originated from the Islamic tradition and refers to a teacher or a scholar, has gained new significance in the modern context of education. With the rise of e-learning, remote education, and Islamic education platforms, Muallam has taken on a new meaning. Muallam is now the title given to educators who teach through digital mediums, delivering lessons over the internet or mobile apps. For instance, on Moodle, a popular e-learning platform, Muallam accounts are created for teachers to manage their virtual classrooms, create quizzes, and communicate with students. Similarly, on Google Classroom, teachers create a virtual classroom for their students where they deliver instruction and assign homework. Lastly, on AlKhansa App, an Islamic education platform, Muallam refers to scholars who deliver lectures on various Islamic subjects like Quranic studies and Hadith. Overall, the role of Muallam in modern education has evolved to include not only traditional classroom teaching but also online and remote instruction.
